ὅδε is used both adjectivally and substantivally.
ὅδε used substantivally, often with an adjective added.

On the use and distinction of the pronouns ὅδε, οὗτος, ἐκεῖνος, see Apollonius' discussion in his book on the pronoun p. 72 (332) and on syntax p. 87 and 99 (compared with Ammonius p. 100 and 106), who rightly noted that they differ in that the first two are near in deixis, while ἐκεῖνος is always said of something at a distance.
